summary: IsoEnergy Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on the NYSE American and TSX, furnished a Form 6-K with a news release dated November 5, 2026, reporting assay results from its completed 2026 summer exploration program at the Larocque East project in the eastern Athabasca Basin. Highlights include 4.17% U3O8 over 2.0 m (15.4% over 0.5 m) in hole LE26-254 roughly 500 m east of the Hurricane deposit, with mineralization confirmed in 18 of 26 holes. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are present; this is routine exploration disclosure, not a special situation.
